result:
I'm marking round 254 **FAIL** on one row, C-SHEET-254. The other runnable rows pass in the real browser at both 1440×900 and 1280×720. The fix is a B decision rather than more A work, because the sheet text is the exact copy the task dictates.

**The failing row (C-R254-01, Low).** The row allows two-line entries only if the shortcut sheet scrolls no more than at HEAD. It now scrolls 1,260 px against 1,230 px at HEAD, so +30 px at both viewports. All 30 px come from text wrapping onto a second line: with wrapping turned off, both measure 1,070 px. The two new rows on their own would add no scroll. A estimated +132 px; the measured delta is +30. B has three options:
- accept the +30 px;
- shorten the texts so each fits on one line;
- change the sheet's width or layout, which needs Saba.

**What passes:**
- **The marker line** is visible, 1 px light ink, and sits where the click was, within 0.1 px. Clicks pass through it to the lane. Where it meets the playhead, the brass playhead paints on top. At HEAD the same element is hidden and 0×0.
- **Blink:** it flashes on a 1.2 s cycle with motion allowed. Under reduced motion it stays fully visible.
- **Contrast:** 13–15.6:1 against lanes, rulers and clip bodies. It is only 1.88:1 on a selected clip's brass title bar; B expected that and it is listed, not failed.
- **Transport behaviour:**
  - After play and stop, the marker and playhead show as two separate lines, and the next Space plays from 0:02.
  - A click while playing moves only the marker, within one frame, and playback continues.
  - The line hides while a time selection exists.
  - Home sends the marker to 0, stopped and while playing. It rewrites the marker value at most twice, never through a third value.
  - The line stays on the ruler's 0:02 tick through zoom and scroll.
- **Unchanged from HEAD:** button titles, Tab order, and the count of always-visible text lines (85/101 at 1440, 69/85 at 1280).
- **Export:** the real WAV export is 16.000 s, 48 kHz/24-bit, with no NaN samples. Its sha256 is identical to round 253.
- **Premium auth is not bypassed.** In a fresh context with no credentials, `/studio-lab` opens, `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required" with no audio, and `/api/studio-token` returns 401, or 500 with a fake token, never 200.
- **Scope, unit tests and mutants:**
  - Only the 8 granted files changed, and the protected and frozen files match.
  - The 7 named test files pass 131/131.
  - My own three mutants turn their rows red, and the unchanged control passes.

The second finding (C-R254-OBS-01, Low) did not cause the FAIL; HEAD behaves the same way. With the marker snapped exactly to the project end at 16.000, the stopped status says Space plays from there, but Space plays from 0:00. It is the same kind of issue as C-R253-01.

I also confirmed A's note that the render-budget test already had a 15 s timeout at HEAD. Rewriting it in the new form removed no assertion.

**Not checked:**
- The purchased-copy route is blocked because there is no backend in the cloud.
- The full test suite, build and verify belong to the root gate.
- I did not load a video to check the floating video's stacking order.

I ran a HEAD comparison server on :5180 and stopped it afterwards. The store source is untouched.

Files are in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- c-round-254.md
- c-round-254.json
- c-round-254/
